posts.title: Claudio's Advise
posts.description: Like many people, I've taken to calling Claude "Claudio." For no particular reason, of course. The other day I asked him what he thought about my habit of jumping from one book to the next, and he suggested a simple approach: give me the bare minimum of theory for whatever area I want to study, then have me practice on problems from free sources online. So far it seems to be working.

posts.title: Guest Editor
posts.description: So this happened: a mid-ranked (Q2) math journal asked me to be the guest editor of a special issue. Well, first of all: wow! You can't imagine how much even the idea excites me. Nevertheless, I'm going to decline, because I think a role like this belongs to a mathematician. posts.description: Hi there. I've been away for a few days.
